run_release_docs: run release_docs.py with a version number to branch Google Test wiki pages for a new release
create_WikiBrancher: create a WikiBrancher instance with a dot version string to prepare wiki file branching for gtest or gmock
branch_WikiBrancher_BranchFiles: branch wiki files by running svn copy commands to create versioned copies of documentation pages
update_WikiBrancher_UpdateLinksInBranche: update internal wiki links in branched files so they point to the new versioned page names
call_DropWikiSuffix: call DropWikiSuffix to remove the .wiki suffix from a wiki filename string
